resources.string: Smart Index builds a private index of your phone so you can find things without knowing where they are.
Search your messages by their words, and find any photo, document, file or call by name or date
See everything that happened on any day in one timeline
Open results in the app of your choice
Private by design: no internet permission, the index stays on this phone and is excluded from backups.
Stays on this phone. Smart Index has no internet access.
Lets you find photos and videos by date, name and folder, with thumbnails in the timeline.

string-array.name: step1_reads
string-array.item: Photos and videos on this phone
Date taken, file name, folder, size, video length

resources.string: Lets you find any document or file by its name, folder or date, and play call recordings. Android will open a settings page — turn on \"Allow access to manage all files\".

string-array.name: step2_reads
string-array.item: Documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text): name, folder, dates, size — not what\'s inside
Other files: name, folder, type, dates, size

resources.string: Lets you search every SMS and MMS, each as its own result — for example a payment message from a specific day.

string-array.name: step3_reads
string-array.item: Sent and received SMS and MMS text

resources.string: Lets you see calls in the timeline, search by name or number, call back, and play the matching recording.

string-array.name: step4_reads
string-array.item: Number, direction (incoming, outgoing, missed), time and duration

resources.string: Shows names instead of numbers for calls and messages, so you can search \"Rahul\" instead of a number.
